items.source: Variant of maxAge(Duration) accepting a value in seconds.
items.translation: 接受秒数值的 `maxAge(Duration)` 变体。

items.source: This limits the scope of the cookie such that it will only be attached to same site requests if "Strict" or cross-site requests if "Lax".
items.translation: 这将限制 Cookie 的作用范围，使其仅在 `"Strict"` 时附加到同一站点请求，或在 `"Lax"` 时附加到跨站点请求。

items.source:
A positive value indicates when the cookie should expire relative
to the current time. A value of 0 means the cookie should expire
immediately. A negative value results in no "Max-Age" attribute in
which case the cookie is removed when the browser is closed.
items.translation: 正值表示相对于当前时间 Cookie 应何时过期。值为 0 表示 Cookie 应立即过期。负值将导致不存在"Max-Age"属性，此时当浏览器关闭时 Cookie 将被移除。
